subject: Scaling LEAP's data infra | Working w/ Skydio & Zipline
text:
Hi [NAME],

Saw LEAP is scaling alongside Puma LE's Universal Gimbal rollout. We work
with autonomous flight teams like Skydio and Zipline, so wanted to reach
out.

Their ML leaders came to us frustrated when:

   1. Tracker failures on flight footage were hard to surface and fix at
   scale
   2. EO/IR curation bottlenecked retraining cycles
   3. ML engineers spent more time on data infra than on algorithm work

In mission-critical UAV work, that data layer makes all the difference.

Worth 15 min to compare notes? Tuesdays and Thursdays usually work well for
me.

subject: Will World Models Eat Physical AI?
text:
Hi [NAME],

We hosted a deep-dive webinar on the future of AI in robotics, and given
your work, I thought you would have found the discussion particularly
relevant.

We brought together Chris Paxton (AI Lead at Agility) and Jason Ma
(Co-founder at Dyna) for a conversation moderated by Encord CEO [SENDER] and Head of Physical AI [SENDER] to debate a central question: "Will
World Models Eat Physical AI?"

The discussion focused on World Models vs. VLAs, real-world deployment
trade-offs, and the data pipelines powering current humanoid and robotics
systems.

Attaching the recording here
<[LINK]>
-
we hope you enjoy the session, and I'd love to hear your thoughts!

subject: OMR/OCR + multi-spectrum imaging | Working w/ Baker Hughes, AbbVie & Hitachi
text:
Hi [NAME],

Saw the OMR/OCR + UV/IR imaging role on the Retail Channel team. We work
with teams at leading corporations like Baker Hughes, AbbVie and Hitachi
who hit the same wall scaling multi-spectrum pipelines: annotating across
modalities, surfacing edge cases their models fail on, and keeping label
quality consistent for production deployment.

Curious whether dataset prep and curation is becoming a bottleneck as you
scale the CV stack.

Worth a quick chat? Tuesdays and Thursdays usually work well for me.

text:

Encord has helped leading financial institutions by providing a scalable platform to help teams gain greater control of their LLM evaluation workflows & support frontier use cases such as agentic AI reasoning + automated output grading at scale. 

I'd love to find some time to connect and share a bit more about what we do. Would you have time to connect on Wednesday or Thursday next week?
